$comment: Corpora indexed by scripts/refs.py. Only this configuration is published; the content is cloned onto the machine that builds the index and never redistributed. Fields: repo (GitHub owner/name), sparse (checkout only these top-level paths), include/exclude (globs relative to the repo root), sections (index prose chunks, not only links), whole_doc (one record per file), context (regex whose ctx group labels records by path), parser (markdown | fcc-blocks), enabled.

sources.name: public-apis
sources.about: Free and public HTTP APIs by category, with auth, HTTPS and CORS flags.
sources.use_for: Finding an external API for a feature, demo or integration test.

sources.name: system-design-primer
sources.about: System design concepts (caching, sharding, consistency, load balancing) and worked interview designs.
sources.use_for: Explaining a scalability concept or trade-off with a citable source; design-interview practice.

sources.name: developer-roadmap
sources.license: Personal use only; do not redistribute content
sources.about: roadmap.sh topic notes with curated resources for about 90 roadmaps (ASP.NET Core, backend, system design, PostgreSQL, Redis, Angular, DevOps, AI engineer...).
sources.use_for: Short topic explainers, what to learn next, and vetted articles or videos per topic.

sources.name: build-your-own-x
sources.about: Tutorials for re-implementing technologies from scratch (database, Docker, Git, Redis, web server...).
sources.use_for: Learning how something works by building a small version of it.

sources.name: project-based-learning
sources.about: Project tutorials grouped by programming language.
sources.use_for: Hands-on projects in a given language, including C#.

sources.name: free-programming-books
sources.about: Free books, courses, screencasts and interactive tutorials in many human languages (file suffix = language, e.g. -uk, -ru, -langs).
sources.use_for: A free book or course on a language or subject, optionally in Ukrainian.

sources.name: coding-interview-university
sources.about: A multi-month computer-science study plan with links for every topic.
sources.use_for: Interview preparation and CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, complexity).

sources.name: awesome
sources.about: The index of awesome lists, one per technology or topic.
sources.use_for: Finding the curated list for a technology before searching the web.

sources.name: awesome-python
sources.about: Python frameworks, libraries and tools by category.
sources.use_for: Picking a Python library for a task.

sources.name: awesome-design-md
sources.about: DESIGN.md files (colors, typography, spacing, components) inspired by well-known product sites.
sources.use_for: Giving a UI task a concrete visual system; copy the chosen file to the project root as DESIGN.md.

sources.name: freecodecamp
sources.about: freeCodeCamp curriculum outline: every block with its lessons, labs and exams (outline only, not lesson text).
sources.use_for: Beginner-to-intermediate curricula and exercise ideas (web, Python, C#, algorithms).
